text: {"danger_level":"red","danger_reason":"City-wide air-raid sirens are sounding while you are outdoors on foot in Thiyagaraya Nagar.","main_move":"GO_DOWN_INSIDE","main_move_text":"Immediately move inside the nearest concrete building, basement, or underground structure away from windows.","where_to_go":"Nearest sturdy concrete building, basement, or underground shelter in Thiyagaraya Nagar","do_now":[{"text":"Run immediately into the nearest sturdy concrete building, basement, or underground facility.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_SHELTER_01"]},{"text":"Move away from glass windows, exterior doors, and open spaces once indoors.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_SHELTER_02"]},{"text":"Crouch low to the ground, cover your head and neck with your arms, and stay protected.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_PROTECT_01"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not stay outside in the open or remain near glass facades and loose structures.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_DONOT_OUTDOORS"]},{"text":"Do not use elevators to seek shelter during an active air alert.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_DONOT_ELEVATOR"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"Outdoors on foot with no visible shelter","text":"Lie flat in a low ditch or depression, facing down, covering your head with your hands.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_OPEN_SPACE_01"]}],"call":["112","100"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"Standard air-raid defense procedures apply immediately to persons caught outdoors during sirens.","unknowns":["Specific locations of designated bomb shelters in the immediate street block"],"valid_while":["Air-raid alert siren remains active","Until official all-clear signal is given"]}
